normative_extracts.quote: The HTML parser processes bytes incrementally as they arrive over the network, constructing DOM nodes and discovering subresources before EOF.

normative_extracts.spec_section: MDN Streams API: ReadableStream Chunked Flushing
normative_extracts.quote: ReadableStream allows servers and workers to enqueue and flush HTML chunks progressively over HTTP/2 or HTTP/3.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Flushes the HTML <head> and shell immediately over HTTP/2+ while slow data queries resolve, then streams deferred <template> chunks + inline swap scripts.

production_failures.symptom: Streaming SSR behaves like buffered SSR (entire page arrives at once after 900ms)
production_failures.root_cause: An intermediate Nginx/CDN gzip buffer or framework middleware waited for the full response body before flushing the first byte.
production_failures.mitigation: Disable proxy response buffering (X-Accel-Buffering: no) and flush the <head> shell immediately.

production_failures.symptom: HTTP 200 status is locked in even though a streamed Suspense boundary threw a 500 error
production_failures.root_cause: HTTP status codes and headers are committed with the very first flushed chunk; errors occurring mid-stream cannot change the status to 500.
production_failures.mitigation: Resolve critical route-level 404/500 checks before flushing the initial response headers, and render graceful fallback UI for deferred boundaries.
